summary: Oatly Group AB filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting. The AGM approved routine matters: adoption of financial statements, no dividend, discharge of liability, election of directors (including new member Stefan Descheemaeker and chair Martin Brok), re-election of auditor Ernst & Young, and implementation of a long-term incentive plan (LTIP 2026-2028). No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, going-private, or restructuring is present. This is a routine AGM outcome report for a foreign private issuer, akin to a standard 8-K Item 5.07 filing under US rules.
